destructiveReason: Deleting a project CASCADES: Kimai also deletes every activity under it and every timesheet booked against the project or those activities. There is no undo.
usageNotes:
Prefer patch_project with visible: false. A finished project that is hidden keeps its billing history and stops cluttering pickers; a deleted one takes its time entries with it.

kimai_call_endpoint snapshots the activities and affected timesheets into the backup before sending the delete.
tips: Check the blast radius first: get_activities with projects[]=<id> and visible=3, then get_timesheets with projects[]=<id> and user=all.
